messages:
maria.design: noticed multiple support tickets where users toggled the sampling slider when they wanted to change the timeframe. proposal: separate timepicker + sampling into distinct affordances.

sam.eng: agree. server supports sample param already. current frontend groups them which causes accidental full/partial queries. we'll add sample=auto|0.1|0.25|0.5|1.

lina.pm: product concern: defaults matter. suggestion: auto mapping: <10m -> 1, 10m-2h -> 0.5, 2h-12h -> 0.25, >12h -> 0.1. include microcopy that "p95 may be estimated when sampling is not 100%".

 dylan.ux: UI approach: keep timepicker as primary control, add a compact secondary control labelled "Sampling" to the right. clicking opens an accessible popover with options Auto / 10% / 25% / 50% / 100% + short help text. show an inline "estimated" badge next to p95 when sample!=1.

 eva.a11y: a11y notes: popover must be reachable by keyboard (enter/space), trap focus, and offer a logical tab order. aria-live region should announce "Chart updated, p95 estimated" when sampling causes estimation. also check color contrast on the badge and popover selection states.

 raj.product: add a safety banner: when sampled p95 deviates >12% from last full-run, surface: "Sampled p95 differs from full-run by X%  View full run". track this as telemetry event `obs_sampling_discrepancy`.

 ci-bot: note: observability API v2 will accept new query param `sample`. rollout scheduled to canary next week.

 sam.eng: implementation details: API contract: GET /api/obs/latency?range=2h&sample=auto. server returns header X-Sampled: true when sample<1. for Dedicated customers, auto->1 by default. we'll also return metadata field sampled=true and sampled_rate=0.25 so frontend can render badges.

 dylan.ux: small UX nit: instead of moving the density slider into the toolbar, consolidate heatmap density + opacity into a single "visual density" control, hide advanced knobs under a chevron. prevents duplication.

 eva.a11y: ensure visual density control has keyboard adjustments with aria-valuemin/valuemax and a text label that reads current setting for screen readers.

 lina.pm: acceptance criteria: mocks for compact and expanded toolbar; microcopy finalized; API documented; telemetry events listed; discrepancy banner threshold config; a11y checklist.

 maria.design: action items: dylan -> produce high-fidelity mocks + keyboard walkthrough by Fri; sam -> wire sample param + headers + server heuristics; eva -> produce a11y checklist and test plan; lina -> finalize copy and opt-in remember preference; raj -> define discrepancy threshold and telemetry. i'll create the handoff doc after mocks. :thumbsup:

 dylan.ux: will prototype keyboard flow and include focus states in the mock.

 eva.a11y: ping me on the deploy branch for quick SR pass.

 maria.design: thanks team. leaving this thread open for follow-ups and smaller copy nits.
